summary.text: Lily Foss is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 41, where she assumed office on December 4, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She works as a fair housing advocate and says housing is a central campaign issue.

paragraphs.text: Lily Foss was born in Manchester, New Hampshire, and graduated from Manchester Memorial High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Scripps College in 2013, and her career experience includes working in advocacy.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Foss said her family first came to Manchester from Ireland in 1905 and that she works as a fair housing advocate doing outreach and education.
She said she is a renter and that she supports affordable and fair housing, including housing choice, and links environmental justice to that issue.
